text.description_html:
Omnia 3918-US32D, Round Brushed Stainless Steel Fingertip Edge Pull

Usually used on sliding pocket doors, the Round Fingertip Edge Pull has a modern look thanks to its brushed stainless steel finish. The finger edge pull is pressure mounted into the door's edge so that you have something to grip in order to slide the door out of the pocket. It has a mere 1/16 inch projection.

Specifications for the Round Small Edge Door Pulls:

  • Material: Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Brushed Stainless Steel
  • Diameter: 1-1/8"
  • Finger Cutout Diameter: 3/4"
  • Door Cutout Length: 13/16"
  • Door Cutout Dimeter: 31/32"
  • Projection: 1/16" (2 mm)

Sold Individually
